description: This file defines the public API for I2S (Inter-IC Sound) bus drivers in the Zephyr project, including data formats, configuration structures, enums for states and commands, and function prototypes for configuring and controlling I2S interfaces.

methods.name: i2s_configure
methods.description: Configures the I2S interface for a specified direction with given settings.

methods.name: i2s_config_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of the I2S interface for a specified direction.

methods.name: i2s_read
methods.description: Reads data from the I2S RX queue into a memory block.

methods.name: i2s_buf_read
methods.description: Reads data from the I2S RX queue into a user-provided buffer.

methods.name: i2s_write
methods.description: Writes data to the I2S TX queue from a memory block.

methods.name: i2s_buf_write
methods.description: Copies data from a user buffer into a TX memory block and queues it for transmission.

methods.name: i2s_trigger
methods.description: Sends a trigger command to control I2S interface operation (start, stop, drain, etc.).
